user.title: Connect Monsieur Cuisine
user.description:
**Unofficial** – not affiliated with Lidl, SilverCrest or Tecpal.

How would you like to sign in?

auto.title: Sign in with Lidl
auto.description:
**Required once:** the small **browser helper**. After login it catches the sign-in code and hands it to Home Assistant automatically – no copying needed.

➡️ **[Download & install the browser helper](https://github.com/MrVain74/ha-monsieur-cuisine/tree/main/browser-helper)** (short guide there, ~1 min – first time only).

Then click **Open website** below and log in to Lidl (e-mail, password, captcha – you do this yourself). This dialog will finish **on its own**.

_No helper? Cancel and choose “Manual”._

manual.title: Manual sign-in
manual.description:
1. Open **[the Lidl sign-in]({login_url})** in a new tab and log in (e-mail, password, captcha – you do this yourself).
2. You will then be redirected to an address starting with `lidl-com…`. Your browser usually shows an error page there – **this is expected**.
3. Copy **the full address** (from the address bar) and paste it below.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in failed. Is the address complete? The code is only valid briefly – if needed, open the Lidl sign-in above again and paste the fresh address.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Monsieur Cuisine cloud. Please try again later.

abort.invalid_auth: Sign-in failed. Please start the login again (the code is only valid briefly).
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Monsieur Cuisine cloud. Please try again later.
abort.no_url: Home Assistant does not know its own URL. Please set one under Settings → System → Network, or use the manual method.

send_recipe.name: Send recipe to Monsieur Cuisine
send_recipe.description: Converts a recipe (web page with schema.org data or JSON) into a Monsieur Cuisine recipe with machine steps and creates it in your account.

url.name: Recipe URL
url.description: Web page with a recipe (schema.org/Recipe, e.g. Chefkoch, Mealie).

recipe.name: Recipe (JSON)
recipe.description: schema.org/Recipe object as an alternative to the URL.

recipe_id.name: Existing recipe
recipe_id.description: ID of one of your recipes to overwrite.

dry_run.name: Preview only
dry_run.description: Do not create anything, just return the detected steps.
